config.label: Transak partner API key (from partner dashboard)
config.description: Transak partner API key (from partner dashboard). Used as partnerApiKey query param on public quote endpoint and bundled with api-secret to mint the access-token for Partner API calls.

config.label: Transak partner API secret
config.description: Transak partner API secret. Sent as the api-secret header to endpoints that require server-to-server authentication (and used to mint access tokens for order endpoints).
